question:
Write an essay on any one of the following topics:
(a) Disaster Management in Mizoram
(b) The role of Youth in National Development
(c) The Law, Social Media and Freedom of Speech and Expression (25)
Write a précis of the following passage in about 1/3rd of the length of the original text.

Fill in the blanks with the correct tense of the verbs given in the brackets:
(a) Something very strange __________ (happen) to me last night.
(b) Have you __________ (tell) your friends?
(c) No, I did not __________ (use) your phone.
(d) She has never __________ (speak) of you.
(e) I’ve found out that you __________ (be) cheating on me. (5×1=5)

Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions:
(a) He congratulated me __________ my success.
(b) Rema is free __________ corruption.
(c) We must be loyal __________ our country.
(d) Alcohol is injurious __________ health.
(e) He will comply __________ my request.
(f) Do not laugh __________ the poor.
(g) They plotted __________ the king.
(h) This reminds me __________ my father.
(i) This milk is inferior __________ that.
(j) She has a great affection __________ her son. (10×1=10)

Correct the errors in the following sentences:
(a) She knows swimming well.
(b) I regard him my brother.
(c) One should love his country.
(d) If I was you, I would not have joined the party.
(e) Leave my arm, please.
(f) He has passion of music.
(g) What is your criteria for admission?
(h) One of our friends have come back.
(i) My coat’s pocket has a hole in it.
(j) Neither of the three boys has passed. (10×1=10)

Rewrite the following sentences as directed:
(a) He thanked me. (change the speech)
(b) The milkman supplies milk. (change the voice)
(c) What a lovely flower! (change to assertive)
(d) Never tell a lie. (change to affirmative)
(e) She bought a house. The house is white. (change to simple sentence)
(f) We are sure of his honesty. (change to complex sentence)
(g) God is present everywhere. (substitute a word for ‘present everywhere’)
(h) Jack is the best student of his class. (use comparative degree)
(i) It was a glorious victory. (change to exclamatory form)
(j) The soldiers were brave. (give opposite of ‘brave’) (10×1=10)

Change the narration of the following sentences :
(a) He shouted at them to let him go.
(b) Macbeth said to his wife, “The time is near when I shall become king”.
(c) He said, “I take exercise in the morning”.
(d) I asked him if he would help me.
(e) She said to me, “You are fortunate”.
(f) She told me that I was the first.
(g) The teacher says to us, “You should never tell lies”. (10×1=10)
(h) The stranger asked me where I lived.
(i) The officer shouted, “Get back to work, all of you!”
(j) The traveller asked the boy if he could show him the way to the nearest police station.

Insert articles where needed: (10×1=10)
(a) __________ Americans are more conservative than you would expect them to be.
(b) The worst part of living in a tent is __________ lack of space.
(c) Swimming is __________ more tiring activity than walking.
(d) Football is __________ more popular than any other sport in Mizoram.
(e) She hopes to make a living as __________ news correspondent for one of the local newspapers.
(f) The event will be broadcasted live on __________ TV.
(g) I try to go for __________ run at least three times a week.
(h) By all accounts he is __________ honest fellow.
(i) How many hours do you work on __________ average?
(j) The king prayed for a child so that he would have __________ heir to his throne.

Make meaningful sentences of the following pairs of words to show their differences in meaning. (5×2=10)
(a) Stationary; Stationery
(b) Affected; Effected
(c) Weather; Whether
(d) Alter; Altar
(e) Council; Counsel

Make meaningful sentences with any five (5) of the following idioms and phrases :
(a) crocodile tears
(b) hard and fast
(c) in full swing
(d) yeoman’s service
(e) red letter day
(f) in the face of
(g) at sixes and sevens
(h) bury the hatchet
(i) to call it a day
(j) at the eleventh hour  (5×2=10)
